column1: How do you feel about our friendship? (Cordial to Companion)
"I'm learning a lot by being around you. I think Magister Irin would be proud."
column2: "I can count on one hand the amount of people I trust. You're one of them."
column3: "The two of us are good together. I think we've got a good thing going."
column4: "Not to be too sappy, but... I really care for you. I hope you know that."

column1: "Traveling with you is a good time. Better than sitting around reading books."
column2: "You've got adventure in your blood, there's no one else I'd rather be around."
column3: "You've made my life way more exciting. I hope I can return the favor!"
column4: "You've changed my life for the better. I don't know how I can ever repay that."

column1: "Things are good! You put up with me, which is more than I can say for most."
column2: "I like hanging around with you, you're always getting into trouble. It's the best!"
column3: "I can be a lot to handle, but you've always been patient with me. I appreciate that."
column4: "I used to not trust anyone. Safer that way. But you? You changed all that."

column1: Let's talk about something else. (Returns to Greetings)
